## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the surrounding scenery before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tells her to get dressed for breakfast. Over a silent meal, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) becomes uncomfortable with Anne's intense imagination and quiet mood, while noticing Matthew's persistent desire to keep the girl. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps with chores, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to see Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), leaving [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) behind as they set off in the buggy.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

> During the drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Anne](../character/anne.md) resolves to enjoy the journey despite her dread of being sent away. Asked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to share her true background, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts her life as an orphan, describing her parents' deaths and her childhood moving between homes and looking after children before being sent to the asylum. Listening to Anne's history, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel deep pity for the neglected child and considers whether they should keep her after all.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's home, where they clarify the mix-up regarding the boy they had requested. Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) arrives and offers to take [Anne](../character/anne.md) in as a servant, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates after seeing Anne's distress and decides to bring her back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew.md). Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) talks it over with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) and agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne.md) up to bed and instructs her on keeping her room tidy and saying her bedtime prayers. Upon learning that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has never said a prayer, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to invent one, resulting in an unconventional prayer from [Anne](../character/anne.md). Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes down to the kitchen and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) that they must properly educate and raise the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) have decided to keep her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), sending [Anne](../character/anne.md) into tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) assigns [Anne](../character/anne.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, though Anne's vivid imagination repeatedly distracts her in both the sitting room and kitchen. After discussing the possibility of finding a friend in [Diana Barry](../character/di.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) is sent to her room, where she finishes learning her prayer and happily daydreams by the window.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's appearance, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to fly into a furious rage and insult Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) in return. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne.md) in her bedroom and demands she apologize, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) fiercely refuses.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> After [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to leave her room or eat, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) secretly visits her and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to smooth things over. [Anne](../character/anne.md) dramatic apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who forgives her completely and offers her hope about her hair color. Walking back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels an unaccustomed warmth toward [Anne](../character/anne.md) as the young girl expresses her happiness at finally having a home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne.md) with three plain new dresses, sparking Anne's disappointment over the lack of fashionable puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache while [Anne](../character/anne.md) decorates her hat with wild flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning, [Anne](../character/anne.md) recounts her experiences at church and Sunday school, including her observations about the other girls' puffed sleeves and the minister's sermon.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) suspects [Anne](../character/anne.md) of taking her missing amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the upcoming picnic, [Anne](../character/anne.md) fabricates a dramatic story about losing the brooch in the water, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway as punishment. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her own lace shawl, apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne.md), and quickly sends her off to enjoy the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits her mistake in suspecting [Anne](../character/anne.md) and forgives her for the false confession, quickly sending her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns overjoyed after having a wonderful time eating ice cream and boating on the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shares the entire story with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), admitting she learned a valuable lesson.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk to school while discussing their classmates, including [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teases [Anne](../character/anne.md) by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she refuses to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana.md) over for tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) attends a meeting in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne.md) inadvertently serves [Diana](../character/diana.md) three glassfuls of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing [Diana](../character/diana.md) to feel dizzy and sick and go home early. On Monday, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns that Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) believes she deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together, whereupon [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the wine bottle and realizes her mistake in storing it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a tearful, romantic farewell after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Consoled by their devotion and a exchanged lock of hair, [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and receives a secret note of friendship from [Diana](../character/diana.md). She dedicates herself to her studies, engaging in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while maintaining her silence toward him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) spend a quiet evening together studying and talking. [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) rushes in to beg for help because her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is gravely ill with croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne.md) hurries to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) home and successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) using her past experience with Mrs. Hammond's children, saving the baby's life. Touched by Anne's rescue, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives her for the past incident with [Diana](../character/diana.md), allowing the two girls to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> After [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne.md) attend a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy the event together. Upon returning home, they leap into the spare-room bed as a game, unwittingly jumping directly onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). The resulting uproar leaves [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) furious and threatens Diana's music lessons, prompting a remorseful [Anne](../character/anne.md) to seek a way to make amends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her mistake with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before going to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to take the blame directly. She bravely confronts the angry Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) and explains her perspective, winning over the old lady with her sincerity and imagination. [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after all, and she and [Anne](../character/anne.md) become firm friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns from school emotional about Mr. Phillips's departure and shares news of the new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. After praising Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and making extensive preparations with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) bakes a layer cake for the minister and his wife's visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During tea, Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sample the cake, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to react in shock at its unusual taste.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) beautifully decorates the tea table for the minister and his wife, and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) manages to join the party. However, disaster strikes when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) tries Anne's layer cake and discovers [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally flavored it with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne.md) flees to her room in tears, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) kindly comforts her and invites her to show off her flower garden.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne.md) eagerly embraces despite Marilla's skepticism. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) criticizes the concert as a distraction from schoolwork, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) warmly encourages Anne's enthusiasm.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> Noticing how plain Anne's dresses are compared to her peers, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) secretly seeks Mrs. Lynde's help after an awkward attempt to shop at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) himself. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) sews a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves, which [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) presents to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning to her immense joy. Later, [Diana](../character/diana.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a pair of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), and the children perform successfully in their evening [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Diana](../character/diana.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md). Later, the children perform in a successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert where [Anne](../character/anne.md) excels in her recitations, despite her initial nerves. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) discuss Anne's performance by the kitchen fire and consider her future education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) walk along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) on Anne's thirteenth birthday, discussing growing up, school assignments, and romantic story plots. [Anne](../character/anne.md) proposes starting a story club to cultivate their imaginations, which eventually expands to include other classmates like Jane and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the story club's progress, defending their work and sharing her aspirations to be like Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prompts her to finish her household chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne.md) in Lover's Lane to share the news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has invited them both to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting permission to go, the girls travel to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), Aunt Josephine's estate, where they enjoy several days of town festivities, concerts, and dining out. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects warmly on the trip and her joy at returning to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) bid farewell to [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md), who realizes how much she enjoyed Anne's lively company. The girls enjoy a picturesque drive back, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) warmly welcome her with a special supper.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a restful summer outdoors per doctor's orders before resuming her studies for the upcoming [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. As the school year progresses, [Anne](../character/anne.md) matures into a quieter fifteen-year-old girl, growing taller than [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and shifting her focus to simple, disciplined writing. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a sense of loss over [Anne](../character/anne.md) growing up, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) worries about the anxiety and potential failure surrounding the crucial exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school term and travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. After weeks of anxious waiting, [Diana](../character/diana.md) rushes to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the published results to reveal that [Anne](../character/anne.md) has tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) alongside [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne.md) shares the proud news with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) before ending her night with a thankful prayer.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md), though leaving [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) brings emotional farewells. Upon arriving in town, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students adjust to their new environment and classes. In her boarding house room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels homesick until her schoolmates visit and share news about an upcoming Avery scholarship, sparking new academic ambitions.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). After commencement, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), reunites with [Diana](../character/diana.md), and learns about Gilbert's plans and Matthew's declining health. She enjoys a peaceful day outdoors and has a tender evening conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) suddenly dies from shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank failure, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) in deep grief. Neighbors come to offer support, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) gradually processes her loss through tears and conversation with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). Later, as life begins to resume its normal routine, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) sit together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) discussing future plans and Marilla's past relationship with John [Blythe](../character/blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> While [Anne](../character/anne.md) daydreams on the doorstep, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) angrily confronts her about her cow getting into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne.md) retorts about his baldness before securing the cow, and later discusses the incident over tea with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). Mrs. Rachel shares local news, including upcoming changes in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and new students expected in Anne's classroom.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> While driving back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) spot a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's wet oat field and chase it into the lane. Believing the cow to be her own mischievous animal, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), an annoyed [Anne](../character/anne.md) impetuously sells it on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers her real cow still in the milking pen and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow. Horrified by her mistake, [Anne](../character/anne.md) packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess to Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md).
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) nervously visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the mistake good-naturedly, accepts Anne's cow in exchange, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a pleasant conversation and bonding over cake and tea, [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to happily report the successful outcome to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins her first day teaching school, forgetting her prepared speech but managing her new pupils, including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and a bright, imaginative boy named [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an excessively dressed Mrs. Donnell visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. On her walk home, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) wild orchids, brightening her mood before she returns to recount her day to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drops by while [Anne](../character/anne.md) is attempting to write, and they discuss their respective teaching experiences, students, and future career ambitions. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves to get a book, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home tired and reveals that her cousin Mary Keith is dying and needs someone to care for her twin children, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) successfully persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take in the twins out of a sense of duty, agreeing to help with their sewing.
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne.md) quickly retrieves the toad and carries it outside to the orchard before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can discover it. Relieved, she notices [Diana](../character/diana.md) signaling to her from her window.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) speaks with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in his bedroom, explaining to him why lying and skipping his prayers leads to bad consequences. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes downstairs and laughs with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about Davy's antics, and the two discuss how best to handle and raise the mischievous boy.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her humorous and charming experiences as a schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny classroom anecdotes, excerpts from her students' compositions, and the story of how [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied an old love letter for her assignment. Finally, she highlights a letter from her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), about his imaginative rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> Suffering from a severe toothache, [Anne](../character/anne.md) has a disastrous and irritable day at school, accidentally throwing a package of fireworks into the stove and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. She returns home distraught over losing her temper, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next day, to Anne's surprise, Anthony shows newfound respect for her, which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) later confirms was earned through the whipping.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) plans a spring outing with [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and Jane to celebrate an adopted spring birthday. During their walk through the woods and pastures, the girls explore unknown paths, name a woodland pool, and discover [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's forgotten garden, where [Diana](../character/diana.md) tells the romantic story of Hester's life.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who talks about church preparations, and upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learn from a letter that the twins will stay with them until fall. [Anne](../character/anne.md) recalls a humorous interaction with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) regarding his antics and misinterpretations of the catechism. Later, at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the group is distressed to hear that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence for advertisements, and an unsuccessful committee sent to reason with him leaves them dismayed.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) completes her school year and walks home, meeting young [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) on her way to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) cemetery. They discuss their loved ones, imagination, and placing flowers on graves. At the cemetery, [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and the two walk home together while discussing teaching, ideals, friendship, and future plans.
>
> — v2 · XV The Beginning of Vacation

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives a letter announcing that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will visit, and she enthusiastically plans a elaborate dinner party with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md). After clearing up Davy's confused ideas about heaven and preparing the house and food, [Anne](../character/anne.md) secures Davy's promise to behave during the upcoming visit.
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) excitedly prepare a elaborate dinner and floral decorations at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a guest, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, chaos ensues when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins the lemon pies, the peas are ruined by being oversweetened by too many cooks, and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up. To cap off the disastrous day, Miss Barry's expensive platter is accidentally smashed, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) injured her ankle.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) sit together in the evening discussing the day's mishaps, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). As they finish talking, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks up the lane.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne.md) about sleep and Marilla's frugality before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) calls [Anne](../character/anne.md) over to see Diana's signal. [Diana](../character/diana.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne.md) about a willow-ware platter at the [Copp](../character/copp.md) home on the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road), which they decide to retrieve the following day. When they arrive at the empty [Copp](../character/copp.md) house, [Anne](../character/anne.md) climbs onto an old duck house to look through the pantry window, falls through the roof, and gets trapped. After sitting through a rainstorm while stuck, [Anne](../character/anne.md) is rescued by Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md), who agrees to entertain selling her the platter over tea.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

> After helping [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) with his evening prayers, [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) where she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). They discuss the progress of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and their upcoming school term before [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to talk with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the next day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolhouse antics and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scares her with stories of her deceased relatives. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) take a walk through the woods and accidentally lose their way while heading to a tea party. Their wrong turn leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they meet the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), who invite them to stay for a pretend tea party.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and they spend an enjoyable evening sharing stories, tea, and candy. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) opens up about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to suggest bringing his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), for a visit. A month later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two quickly form a warm and fond connection.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> After anonymous newspaper notes predict a severe storm, an unusually devastating hailstorm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and windows. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins shelter through the tempest, later learning that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed and an eyesore house was struck by lightning. Neighbors assess the ruin, and [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md) basks in his newly acquired fame as a prophet.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) how he and his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), originally separated over housecleaning habits and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), leading to their eventual reconciliation. [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns and warmly welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md), after which [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) are present.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's passing, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) come to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne.md) can attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts the opportunity with mixed emotions and resigns her teaching post, prompting reactions from her pupils and [Diana](../character/diana.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> During dinner, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her outfit and shares stories from school while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tries to keep him in line. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). While [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes and talks about his grandmother's strict rules, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) chat before [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes strawberry picking with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends an evening in the garden with [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her desire to go on living. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves, [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on life and death while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) chat about the snowy weather and rising prices. [Anne](../character/anne.md) then reads aloud a humorous letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), who reports on local news from home including Mrs. Lynde's misadventures, his school essay, and various neighborhood gossip.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.

> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship as [Diana](../character/diana.md) nervously prepares to walk down the aisle. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) escorts [Anne](../character/anne.md) home and they take a moonlight walk through Lovers' Lane. During their walk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her plans to substitute as a teacher in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and feels a bittersweet nostalgia for how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has changed.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.

Friends and family arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the ceremony, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), as well as [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and her husband. > [Anne](../character/anne.md) awakens on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her past in her little room. Friends and family gather as preparations finish and [Anne](../character/anne.md) marries [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the sunshine of the old orchard. After a joyous celebration, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary as their loved ones bid them farewell.

They share a conversation about their surroundings, beauty, and pasts before agreeing to exchange visits. Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia join as dinner guests, engaging in lively debate and storytelling over the holiday meal.

Tragically, the baby dies shortly after birth, devastating [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their friends. [Anne](../character/anne.md) endures a long, difficult recovery filled with deep grief, struggling to reconcile her loss while receiving support from her loved ones.

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) gives birth to a healthy ten-pound baby boy, bringing immense joy to the household after her earlier grief. Friends and family visit to admire the newborn, whom [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md) after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
